title: TDS rates in force (Part II of the Finance Act's First Schedule)
description: The rates in force at which tax is deducted under section 393(1) [Table: Sl. Nos. 1(i) and 5], 393(2) [Table: Sl. Nos. 7, 8, 9 and 17] and 393(3) [Table: Sl. Nos. 1, 2 and 3] of the Income-tax Act, 2025, by payee and nature of income, as Part II of the First Schedule to the Finance Act, 2026 gives them from 1 April 2026. Section 2(90) of the Income-tax Act, 2025 takes these rates from the Finance Act of the relevant year, and the Finance Act, 2026 gives effect to the proposals for the financial year 2026-27, so its rates end on 31 March 2027 and the set holds none after that day until the next Finance Act is added. For 393(2) [Table: Sl. Nos. 7, 8, 9 and 17], section 2(90)(c) applies instead the rate of an agreement under section 159 where that is the one applicable. For item 1(b)(i), “investment income” and “non-resident Indian” have the meanings of section 212 of the Act (Part II, Note). The surcharge and the cess are in their own set.

Income-tax Act, 2025 (30 of 2025), section 2(90)(a)(iv) and (c): the rates in force for deducting tax under these entries are “the rate or rates of income-tax specified in this behalf in the Finance Act of the relevant year” ((a)(iv)) and those “specified in this behalf in the Finance Act of the relevant tax year” ((c))
Finance Act, 2026 (4 of 2026), long title: “An Act to give effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the financial year 2026-27.”
